The '''Wasteland''' was a large desert region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prine]]. A large [[Unidentified bovid species|bovid]] was native to the area.

It was occupied by at least one [[Unidentified caravan|band]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. [[Dass Jennir]] and [[Ember Chankeli]] crashed in the Wasteland aboard [[Dezono Qua's starship]] after being attacked by two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]].
